posts.name: KillerTaco
posts.cooked:
Hello everyone!

I'm Clinton (aka KillerTaco, my name from BGG and BoardGaming.com), I'm from CT and I'm new to this forum. In the weeks following christmas I was able to get the Enhanced Edition, the Rook City expansion, the Infernal Relics expansion and the Ambuscade mini-expansion. I am blown away by this game, it is incredible. I had no qualms at all about rating it a solid 10 on BoardGameGeek. A big thanks to Greater Than Games for creating this masterpiece.

I have been HEAVILY promoting SotM at my gaming group, the Waterbury Area Gaming Society and people appear to be enjoying it. We have a meet coming uop this Sunday and I can't wait for SotM to hit the table! This is the greatest superhero game ever to come out and I don't see anything stealing that crown in the near future. I'm also excited to see what Greater Than Games has planned for the future.

Okay, enough gushing from this fanboy.
